item.title: VanEck criticizes Metaplanet over executive dilution despite compensation cuts
item.description: VanEck said Metaplanet’s executive equity exposure remains well above its digital asset treasury peers, even after the company cut its potential share pool by 41%.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
item.description: Bastion Platforms National Trust Company will offer stablecoin custody and wallets, payment infrastructure and white-label issuance from a single federally regulated entity.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Hong Kong jails former banker over $1.6B false credit, cryptocurrency bribes: Report
item.description: Former banking official gets four years in prison over false letters of credit and accepting $470,000 in cryptocurrency bribes.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Coinbase files to bring single-stock perpetual futures to US market
item.description: Coinbase wants to bring 24/5 perpetual futures trading to individual US stocks, with its proposed contracts now awaiting regulatory approval.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Binance launches 24/7 FX perps with weekend pricing system
item.description: Binance is joining a growing number of crypto exchanges offering around-the-clock exposure to foreign exchange markets through perpetual futures.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Crypto stocks rebound after CLARITY Act selloff
item.description: Coinbase, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks rallied Friday as the CFTC and SEC moved ahead with crypto-related actions under existing authority.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: CFTC submits crypto market regulation plan for White House review
item.description: The US commodities regulator submitted a new crypto market regulatory action for White House review days after the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin hits $81K as US bond yields rebound on global oil woes
item.description: Bitcoin price action made swift gains at the start of Friday’s Wall Street trading session as US 30-year bond yields began rising again.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Banks double on EU MiCA crypto provider list as share hits 23%
item.description: Banks now represent nearly one in four providers on ESMA’s MiCA register after roughly doubling their presence since late June.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Ethereum Institutional signals support for Ethlabs’ motion to reduce Ethereum block times
item.description: The non-profit signaled support for reducing Ethereum block times, citing increasing institutional activity moving onto the smart-contract network.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: HYPE hits record above $90 as Hyperliquid launches manual borrowing
item.description: HYPE hit a record $90.92 after Hyperliquid opened manual borrowing, letting users borrow stablecoins against HYPE and Bitcoin collateral.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Dragonfly’s Qureshi calls for end to Zcash dev fund after 2028
item.description: Industry watchers are debating the fate of the Zcash development fund after the ZEC token’s rally pushed its value above $95 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin adds to bull-market hopes as price metric prints fourth-ever bullish cross
item.description: The Fisher Transform indicator produced a rare crossover for only the fourth time in Bitcoin’s history.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Stablecoin payments firm dtcpay closes $25M round with SBI backing
item.description: Dtcpay plans to expand its merchant network and payment products after completing a $25 million Series A backed by Japan’s SBI Group.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Binance brushes off Lagarde MiCA speculation, reaffirms Europe commitment
item.description: Binance declined to address reports of ECB intervention in its Greek MiCA bid, saying it remains committed to securing authorization in Europe.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin cycle bottom may already be in at $58K, says analyst James Check
item.description: Onchain analyst James Check says Bitcoin may have bottomed near $58,000 after two capitulations and warns against anchoring to an October low.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Zcash targets November for NU7 mainnet upgrade with 25-second blocks
item.description: NU7 will cut Zcash block times to 25 seconds and preserve its halving schedule, with testnet activation planned for Oct. 6.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Cardano’s IOG warns users to avoid YouTube channel amid apparent hijack
item.description: Input Output Group told users to avoid its YouTube channel after it began livestreaming a suspected AI-manipulated Charles Hoskinson video promising to “double your wealth.”
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money
item.description: World Money is rolling out across more than 150 countries, combining stablecoin payments, digital asset rewards and trading in a self-custodial app.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: US sanctions Iran’s BitBank, saying it processes ‘Hormuz Safe’ Bitcoin payments
item.description: US Treasury says the Iranian exchange processed payments received through Iran’s Strait of Hormuz maritime scheme and helped move hundreds of millions of dollars in Bitcoin to the IRGC.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: North Korea drives onchain malware surge, CoinEx shuts: Asia Express
item.description: North Korea and Iran account for the majority of onchain malware, while Malaysia has been named among the most crypto curious Islamic nations.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
item.description: The US regulator’s move could make it easier for crypto wallets and other apps to offer access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: WisdomTree, MoonPay team up to expand US access to tokenized money market fund
item.description: MoonPay plans to use WisdomTree’s $1.2 billion WTGXX tokenized fund as part of its stablecoin reserves while helping expand access to US investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Is there any chance left to save the CLARITY Act?
item.description: CLARITY isn’t dead after failing a key Senate vote, but with time running short and Democrats still demanding changes, its path forward is narrowing.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Bitcoin coils near $76.5K as US stocks rebound from Fed rate hike
item.description: Bitcoin made modest daily gains as US stocks saw upside in the aftermath of the US Federal Reserve’s first interest-rate hike since July 2023.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Zcash miner Fortitude taps former Hut 8 CEO to lead ahead of public listing
item.description: Former Hut 8 CEO Jaime Leverton will take the helm at Fortitude as the Zcash-focused miner expands its operations and moves toward a planned public listing.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO
item.description: Crypto.com’s CEO said its sister exchange was cleared to offer US access to single-stock perpetual futures, as the latest platform to bridge TradFi and digital assets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: SEC grants temporary exemption for tokenized US stock trading
item.description: The SEC’s Innovation Exemption allows limited tokenized US stock trading on onchain venues with trading caps and transparency requirements.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin treasury firms can outperform BTC... but is the risk worth taking?
item.description: Bitcoin treasury companies promise to amplify returns over investing in Bitcoin alone, but does the potential upside outweigh the risks to the downside?
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben
